title: Shinonome Ena — Enjoyable Afternoon, Uncertain Future〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Ena's Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Yawn*
Mhm... I slept great...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wait, it's still morning...?!
I thought I went to sleep around dawn.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I was only asleep for four hours?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I'm going back to sleep...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, I'm fully awake now...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I should just get up.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Now then...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Since I managed to wake up early for a change, I should practice drawing something...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But what...?)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What if it's because your sketch has some sort of special place in Mafuyu's heart?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: This lake was born out of Mafuyu's feelings.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Seeing your sketch may've had some sort of effect on her. That might be why you're seeing it floating around now.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: My sketch had an effect on her...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (My sketch had a real effect on her...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (If I can draw something like that again...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(That's it...!
Instead of just Mafuyu, I should try drawing everyone in N25 today.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Where'd that video of all of us go...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, this...! When we went to PXL together!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
It turned out really well.
And the angle's perfect!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, wait, I need to keep looking...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, this one's from... The time we went on that mystery tour.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: We saw those cherry blossoms together and...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: They were so beautiful...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I'll try drawing something based on this.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I wonder what was going through everyone's mind that day...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Oh yeah, Mizuki tried to surprise us by hiding the fact that the place we were going to was supposedly haunted.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Always trying to mess with people...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mizuki also suggested that we take this picture together, so... Okay, I'll go with it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Alright, I think Mizuki turned out pretty good.
Next is Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (How was Kanade behaving this day?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, right. She was petrified over the thought of going somewhere that was haunted.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But Mafuyu dragged her through that tunnel believing it'd inspire her to compose more songs...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Also, I didn't know at the time how big a scaredy cat Kanade was.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Next, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (She disappeared for a minute when we went to that abandoned school. We tried looking for her and ended up discovering that cherry blossom tree in full bloom...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And we talked about a bunch of stuff while standing in front of it...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Despite everything that happened throughout the day, we all seemed to feel the same while looking at those cherry blossoms...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But what were we feeling? How do I describe that in words?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I guess a visual representation would look something like...this? No, that doesn't seem right at all...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Ugh...
I don't know how to put that feeling into words or art!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I need to dig deeper and find a way to really express what we felt...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, Mizuki seemed a bit conflicted back then.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Mizuki...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I wonder... Is Mizuki still...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
No, I promised that I'd wait!
For now, focus on drawing!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright, I've got the general composition down...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hmm... But is this drawing really gonna have an effect on the others?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
What if I did something like this...?
No, that doesn't feel right... Okay, how about...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
No, I can't figure it out...
And I feel like it's starting to lose its initial meaning...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Argh! It's so hard to illustrate how all four of us are feeling all at once!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I should start over...

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Ena, are you asleep? I'm coming in.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? Mom...?

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Oh, you're awake.
You need to get ready for school or you're going to be late.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But it's still before noon... Wait, huh?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mom, why didn't you tell me sooner?!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: I tried multiple times.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Oh, were you drawing something just now? You must've been really focused on it...

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Lately, you've been showing how that part of your father is also—

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Oh, nothing.
Anyway, would you like something to eat before you go?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I am hungry, but I'm gonna be late if I don't go now...

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Then, take some of the rice balls I left in the kitchen.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, I can have them before class! Thanks, Mom!
